name: ta.tsi
notes: Corrected semantics (see docs/ECOSYSTEM.md and tests/reference-pine-vectors.test.ts): PC = ta.change(source) (1-bar change) and the result is a RATIO in [-1, 1], not x100. With constant +1 changes both double-smoothed branches converge to 1, so the ratio is +1 from the bar where the outer EMA seeds (bar 7). Pinned bit-for-bit against PineScript-exported values on daily BTCUSD data in tests/reference-pine-vectors.test.ts (source: OakScriptJS MIT test suite).
